llm.summary: This is a documentation-only Gladia skill for configuring audio intelligence features, with sensitive-data considerations users should handle deliberately.

dimensions.detail: The skill purpose coherently matches its capability: guidance for Gladia transcription intelligence features including translation, NER, sentiment, PII redaction, summarization, and audio-to-LLM. These can process sensitive audio or transcripts, but that is expected for the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to user-directed configuration examples and recommend the official SDK, with raw REST only as a fallback. No hidden commands, prompt overrides, automatic execution, or unrelated behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Artifacts are markdown documentation files only, with no executable scripts, package installs, dependency declarations, or install-time behavior. Static scan and VirusTotal telemetry were clean.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Use of a third-party audio provider is proportionate to the skill's purpose, but users should understand that enabling these features may send recordings, transcripts, and derived metadata to Gladia or downstream model processing.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill itself creates no persistence, background workers, local indexing, or privilege escalation. It documents custom metadata stored with Gladia jobs, which is disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing or using this skill, confirm that recordings and transcripts are allowed to be processed by Gladia and any downstream LLM features. Obtain consent where required, avoid unnecessary sensitive audio, enable only the features you need, and review provider retention, regional processing, and compliance settings for regulated data.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The scanner's privacy concern is valid as user guidance: audio intelligence features may involve sensitive spoken data. The artifacts disclose these features and do not add hidden collection or unrelated data access, so this does not justify Review by itself.
[SQP-2] expected: The referenced pre-recorded audio documentation describes PII redaction, NER, summarization, chapterization, and audio-to-LLM as feature configuration. The missing consent/minimization warning is a documentation gap, not evidence of deceptive or purpose-mismatched behavior.
